question: Which freedom fighter started the newspaper Al-Hilal?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Maulana Abl Kalam Azad__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Al-Hilal was a weekly Urdu language newspaper established by the Indian Muslim independence activist **Maulana Abul Kalam Azad.**
 
• The paper was notable for its criticism of the British Raj in India and its exhortation to Indian Muslims to join the growing Indian independence movement.
 
• Al-Hilal ran from **1912 to 1914,** when it was shut down under the Press Act.
 
• The first edition of Al-Hilal was published in **Calcutta** in **1912.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Maulana Abul Kalam Azad **was an Indian independence activist, Islamic theologian, writer and senior leader of the Indian National Congress. 
 
• He became the First Minister of Education in the Indian government.
 
• In October 1920, Azad was elected as a member of the foundation committee to establish **Jamia Millia Islamia at Aligarh in U. P.**
